occurrences.exact_claim: Privacy Policy What this policy covers This policy explains how personal information submitted through this website is handled. The public site-operator label is Structure Co Concreters Camden. The accountable legal entity remains [[PLACEHOLDER: accountable legal entity for privacy obligations]] and this policy must not be published until that entity is identified. Operating model Structure Co Concreters Camden manages concreting enquiries and coordinates suitable independent providers. Job-specific quotations, contractual terms, licensing, insurance and warranty information must be confirmed before work begins. Submitting an enquiry does not create a construction contract. What is collected The planned enquiry form may collect a name, phone number, suburb, requested service, optional email address, approximate job size and a free-text message. It must not collect payment details. Why it is collected and disclosed Information is used to respond to the enquiry and, with the submitter's consent, may be shared with a suitable independent provider so that the provider can assess the enquiry. It is not sold, rented or disclosed for third-party marketing. Delivery, storage and retention Form submissions are to be delivered to info@concreterscamden.com.au. [[VERIFY: form delivery, authenticated sending domain, database storage and access controls before publication.]] Enquiry records are retained for [[PLACEHOLDER: owner-decided retention period]] and then deleted unless a lawful obligation requires otherwise. Consent and contracts The form must require consent to contact the submitter, store the supplied information and share it with a suitable independent provider for the enquiry. Consent is not pre-ticked and may be withdrawn. Submitting an enquiry does not create a construction contract. Access, correction and complaints Requests to access, correct or delete personal information may be sent to info@concreterscamden.com.au or made by telephone on (03) 4328 3392. Postal correspondence may be sent to 15 Murray Street, Camden NSW 2570. This is an administrative correspondence office and is not open to customers or visitors. We will respond within a reasonable period. Complaints may also be made to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au . Cookies and analytics [[VERIFY: confirm which analytics or tracking scripts are installed before publication and describe them here, or state that none are present.]] Changes If this policy changes, the revised version will be published on this page. Effective date: [[PLACEHOLDER: publication date]].
